title: FOR WOMEN, LIFE, FREEDOM: A PARTICIPATORY AI-BASED SOCIAL WEB ANALYSIS OF A WATERSHED MOMENT IN IRAN’S GENDER STRUGGLES
reasoning: The paper conducts a computational social web analysis of Twitter discourse during the 2022 Iranian protests. While it classifies stances on gender equality within a religious-political context (the Islamic Republic), it does not evaluate or benchmark religious doctrines, ethical frameworks, or moral reasoning within the AI system itself; rather, it uses AI as a tool for sociological analysis.
